Grasp of the Undying.effect: Entering combat generates 1 stack/sec for 3s (refreshes in combat), up to 4. At max stacks, next basic attack on an enemy champion within 5s consumes them: bonus magic damage = 3.5% max HP (ranged 1.4%), heals 1.3% max HP (ranged 0.52%), permanently +5 bonus health (ranged +2). No listed cooldown.

Aftershock.effect: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants 45 bonus armor and MR (+75% of bonus armor/MR) for 2.5s, each capped at 80-150 (by level). Then a shockwave deals 25-120 (by level) + 8% bonus health magic damage in 350 radius. Cooldown 20s. Not triggered on displacement-immune targets.

Guardian.effect: Guard allies within 350 units (or 3s via unit-targeted abilities). If you or a Guarded ally would take 50-178.53 (by level) damage within 2.5s or lethal damage, both gain a shield of 40-162.94 (by level) +20% AP +6% bonus health for 2s. Cooldown 75-35.88s (by level), only when shield triggers.

Demolish.effect: Basic attacks on a turret stack up to 3; third stack consumes them for bonus physical damage 85 + 28% max health (ranged 50 + 20%). Cooldown 30s. Same turret cannot be triggered more than once every 3s. Stacks do not expire.

Font of Life.effect: Slowing or immobilizing an enemy champion heals you and the nearest, most wounded allied champion within 1000 units for 10-54.71 (melee) / 7-38.29 (ranged), based on level. Cooldown 20s. No nearby ally required.

Shield Bash.effect: Whenever you gain a shield, your next attack against an enemy champion deals 5-32.94 (by level) +2.5% bonus health +15% shield amount bonus adaptive damage on-hit. Empowerment lasts up to 2s after the shield expires. One attack per shield. No listed cooldown.

Conditioning.effect: After 12 minutes, gain 8 bonus armor and 8 bonus magic resistance, and total armor and magic resistance are increased by 3%.

Second Wind.effect: After taking damage from an enemy champion, regenerate 4% of missing health over 10 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage. Does not trigger on damage reduced to 0, dealt to shields, or absorbed by invulnerability.

Bone Plating.effect: After taking damage from an enemy champion, for 1.5s the next 3 spells or attacks from that champion deal 30-63.53 (by level) less damage (also true damage). Triggering hit not reduced. Cooldown 55s, starts after duration even if unused.

Overgrowth.effect: Every 8 monsters or enemy minions dying within 1400 range permanently grants a stack (+3 bonus health each, unlimited). At 15 stacks (120 units), base and bonus health increased by 3.5%.

Revitalize.effect: Grants 5% heal and shield power. Outgoing healing/shielding +10% on targets below 40% max health. Incoming healing/shielding and self-healing/shielding +10% while you are below 40% max health.

Unflinching.effect: While afflicted by crowd control from enemy champions, gain 10 bonus armor and 10 bonus magic resistance, lingering 2 seconds after the impairment ends. Kinematics and disruption do not trigger it.

Hextech Flashtraption.jp: ヘクステックフラッシュネイター
Hextech Flashtraption.effect: While Flash has over 2s cooldown remaining, it is replaced by Hexflash: channel up to 2s (movement speed 0), then blink 200-400 units (by channel time) and gain 50% movement speed for 0.25s. Cooldown 20s; releasing before 1s or entering champion combat puts it on 10s cooldown.

Magical Footwear.effect: After 12 minutes (reduced 45s per champion takedown), receive free Slightly Magical Boots granting +10 bonus movement speed. Cannot buy Boots or Tier-2 boots before obtaining them.

Cash Back.effect: Upon purchasing a Legendary item, refunded 7.5% of its total gold cost. Selling or undoing cancels the refund.

Triple Tonic.jp: トリプル トニック
Triple Tonic.effect: Gain an Elixir at level 3 (Elixir of Avarice), level 6 (Elixir of Force) and level 9 (Elixir of Skill).

Time Warp Tonic.jp: タイムワープトニック
Time Warp Tonic.effect: Consuming a Health Potion or Refillable Potion additionally heals 40% of its total health restoration.

Biscuit Delivery.jp: ビスケットデリバリー
Biscuit Delivery.effect: Receive a Total Biscuit of Everlasting Will at 2:00, 4:00 and 6:00. Consuming (or selling) one permanently grants +30 maximum health (bonus health, does not raise current health).

Cosmic Insight.effect: Gain 18 summoner spell haste and 10 item haste.

Approach Velocity.effect: Gain 7.5% bonus movement speed while facing visible enemy champions that are immobilized, grounded or slowed within 1000 range. Doubled to 15% (no range cap or vision needed) toward champions whose movement you impaired.

Jack of All Trades.effect: 1 Jack stack per unique stat type from items; each stack grants 1 ability haste. At 5 stacks: +4.8 AD or 8 AP (adaptive). At 10 stacks: additional +7.2 AD or 12 AP (total 12 AD or 20 AP).

Boots of Swiftness.jp: スイフトネス ブーツ
Boots of Swiftness.effect: +55 movement speed. Passive: 25% slow resist. Recipe: Boots + 700g.

Plated Steelcaps.jp: プレート スチールキャップ
Plated Steelcaps.effect: +25 armor, +45 movement speed. Passive Plating: reduces incoming basic attack damage by 10% (not turret attacks). Recipe: Boots + Cloth Armor + 600g.

Mercury's Treads.jp: マーキュリー ブーツ
Mercury's Treads.effect: +20 magic resistance, +45 movement speed, +30% tenacity. Recipe: Boots + Null-Magic Mantle + 550g.
